dynamicSlides.title: CONSUMER PLATFORMS
dynamicSlides.tagline: Most consumer platforms do not have a feature problem. They have a value-realisation problem. The constraint is not access to technology. It is how quickly and consistently the platform creates value for the user—and for the business.

dynamicSlides.title: INTELLIGENT PLATFORM EVOLUTION
dynamicSlides.tagline: Static consumer journeys are giving way to platforms that learn and adapt. AI matters when it changes the behaviour of the platform—not merely when it adds a chatbot.
dynamicSlides.leftText:
by themselves.
What the business experiences
• High onboarding drop-off
• Low use beyond one or two obvious features
• Engagement falls after the initial need is met
• Notifications create activity but not durable value
• Churn remains difficult to explain or reverse
dynamicSlides.rightText:
Why it persists
• Users do not reach first value quickly enough
• The product does not recognise different intents
• Feature discovery depends on menus or
campaigns
• Return triggers are generic rather than
contextual
• Teams optimise screens instead of the full
behaviour loop
The opportunity: design activation, habit and retention into the product—not as communication added after launch.
